downstream.large_packet: Burgess pointwise saving now supplies the large side branch of the four-interval character moment
downstream.not_row_column_yet: the later promotion from RKS23 character moment to row/column theorem remains a separate audit gate
downstream.rks23_character_moment: large plus thin branches close the RKS23 threshold dichotomy gate author-side

plain_conclusion: B4 闭合后，经典 Burgess 的剩余已不再是黑箱。本证书把 Pólya-Vinogradov/归纳启动、ab 移位平均、Hölder 三账本、Vinogradov 重数计数、B4 完全 2r 矩输入、以及 `A,B,r` 参数优化接成一条作者侧内部链，得到素模非主角色在 `|I|>=P^(1/4+epsilon_B)` 区间上的固定幂节省。结合已闭合薄包吸收，RKS23 四区间角色矩阈值门闭合。审稿边界仍保持清楚：这还不是行/列最终命题无条件闭合，下一步必须审查 RKS23 角色矩到行/列推广门是否已经全部登记。

proof_ledger.B0_pv_induction_shell: finite Fourier completion gives Polya-Vinogradov |S|<<P^(1/2)log P; trivial bound handles very short N; the middle range is handled by induction on N
proof_ledger.B1_interval_translation: for H=AB<N, average S(M+ab,N) over 1<=a<=A,1<=b<=B; endpoint discrepancies are shorter sums and are absorbed by the induction majorant E(H)
proof_ledger.B2_vinogradov_shift_amplification: after multiplying by a inverse mod P, the averaged sum becomes H^(-1) sum_x nu(x) sum_{b<=B} chi(x+b)
proof_ledger.B3_holder_and_vinogradov_count: Holder gives V<=V1^(1-1/r)V2^(1/(2r))W^(1/(2r)); V1=AN and the standard congruence count gives V2<=C AN(AN/P+log^2 P)
proof_ledger.B4_complete_moment_import: the previous selector-to-Kummer certificate supplies W<=C_r(B^r P+B^(2r)P^(1/2))
proof_ledger.B5_parameter_choice: take B about r P^(1/(2r)) and A about N/(C_r P^(1/(2r))); then H=AB is a fixed fraction of N and V/H has Burgess exponent (r+1)/(4r^2)
proof_ledger.B6_dyadic_uniformity: all endpoint splits, dyadic labels and fixed packet choices add only constants or P^o(1), absorbed into a smaller delta_B for P>=P_0(epsilon_B)

rejected_shortcuts.no_b4_reopen: the complete rational-sum kernel remains imported from the selector-to-Kummer closure and is not re-proved here
rejected_shortcuts.no_empirical_input: no finite runner or absence-of-counterexample audit is used as a proof input
rejected_shortcuts.no_external_burgess_black_box: the certificate does not count classical Burgess as an imported theorem; it registers the internal proof ledger after B4
rejected_shortcuts.no_row_column_jump: closing Burgess/RKS23 character moment is not identical to closing every row/column promotion gate

rows.meaning: 上一证书已闭合 B4，并把唯一 Burgess 剩余指向 B4 后放大矩账本。
完全有理函数角色和内核已由 selector/Kummer/Stepanov 链闭合。
Pólya-Vinogradov 启动门、平凡短区间门和中区间归纳外壳已登记。
ab 移位平均和乘法反演把原区间和转成带权短移位和。
Hölder 与 `V1,V2,W` 三账本、以及 `V2` 的 Vinogradov 同余计数已闭合。
选择 `B~rP^(1/(2r))`, `A~N/(C_rP^(1/(2r)))` 得到经典 Burgess 指数。
环绕区间拆分、dyadic 包和多对数损耗均可由固定 `epsilon_B` 的 `delta_B` 吸收。
经典 Burgess 点态证明组件在 B4 后作者侧闭合。
素模非主乘法角色在 `P^(1/4+epsilon_B)` 以上区间的点态幂节省闭合。
大包 Burgess 与已闭合薄包吸收合并，RKS23 四区间角色矩阈值门闭合。
本轮关闭 Burgess/RKS23 角色矩输入，但不自动关闭后续行/列推广与最终命题门。

theorem_statement.character: nonprincipal multiplicative character chi mod P
theorem_statement.constant_discipline: C_r and the lower threshold P_0(r) depend only on r, hence only on fixed epsilon_B
theorem_statement.interval: any consecutive interval I, with a wrapping interval split into at most two intervals
theorem_statement.large_interval_saving: if |I|>=P^(1/4+epsilon_B), choose r with 1/(4r)<epsilon_B and obtain |S_I|<=|I| P^(-delta_B) for large P
